acquisition method: The 10 most intense ions were fragmented by higher-energy collisional dissociation
alkylation reagent: alkylation with 55 mM iodoacetamide in 25 mM NH4HCO3
alkylation concentration: alkylation with 55 mM iodoacetamide in 25 mM NH4HCO3
cleavage agent: in-gel digestion with trypsin using a Freedom EVO150 robotic platform
enrichment method: The ALA10-GFP fusion protein was purified from 10-day plantlets by GFP-affinity
fractionation method: Proteins immunopurified from the L2 plant extract were run on a SDS-PAGE gel
instrument: analyzed via online nano-LC–MS/MS (Ultimate 3000 RSLCnano and Q-Exactive Plus, Thermo Fisher Scientific)
ionization type: Spray voltage was set at 1.5 kV and heated capillary was adjusted to 250°C
labeling: The mass spectrometry proteomics data have been deposited to the ProteomeXchange Consortium via the PRIDE partner repository with the dataset identifier PXD019412
reduction reagent: reduction was carried out with 10 mM DTT in 25 mM NH4HCO3
reduction concentration: reduction was carried out with 10 mM DTT in 25 mM NH4HCO3
